# Pencil Agent

> Open-source tool from Really Good Work Inc. Circle something on your live website with Apple Pencil (iPad) or a finger (phone), say or type what should change, and Claude Code edits the code on your Mac. The page reloads with the fix. Free, MIT licensed.

## How it works

1. Circle what you want changed. Apple Pencil on an iPad, or a finger on a phone.
2. Say or type the change, e.g. "Make this our brand orange."
3. Your Mac gets the note with the element, its text and its source file (about 60 tokens per note).
4. Claude Code edits the file. The page reloads and the note turns green.

- Finding the element: it asks the browser what sits under the middle of the circle, then steps out to the parent while the circle still covers 70% of it.
- Reading marks: loose stroke measurements, not picture recognition. Circle, box, arrow (move), X and strike-through (remove), underline (emphasise), handwriting inside a box (label).
- Voice: keyboard dictation, or whisper.cpp running on the Mac. No paid transcription.
- Modes: headless (`claude -p`), relay (a live Claude Code session claims notes), and MCP.
- Format: Agentation Annotation Format Schema (AFS) v1.1.

## Requirements

- A Mac with Node.js 20.6+, Claude Code signed in, and your app's dev server.
- An iPad or iPhone. Tailscale (free) connects them from any network and gives HTTPS for the mic. Same Wi-Fi works without it.

## Security

- The server binds 127.0.0.1, rejects unknown Host headers, and checks a token and the app's exact origin on every request.
- The agent may only read, search, edit and write files. No terminal, no internet.
- Notes, sketches and voice stay on the Mac. Development only; never injected into production builds.

## Try it

```
git clone https://github.com/reallygoodwork/pencil
cd pencil
npm run demo
```
